Focus.description: Focus your mind, raising your attack. Stacks, but only so far.

Guard Break.description: Martial form drilled into every student. Shatters the target's guard and lowers its defense.

Sunder.description: A committed overhead cleave, taught in the academy's advanced blades class.

Cinder.description: A first-year cantrip. Scholar's fire bites through armor as if it weren't there.

Altar Mark.description: Channel the rune on your wrist. The spirit of the fallen feeds you as it refines your body.

Dull Sword Slash.description: Not much, but it is yours, and you have used it your whole life.

Evil Plot.description: The enemy schemes, raising its attack.

Bloom Swap.description: The enemy drains your life force.

Stoney Punch.description: A heavy punch made of stone.

Shriek.description: A piercing cry that weakens your resolve.

Venomous Bite.description: A venomous fang sinks into you.

Toxic Lash.description: A toxic strike that drains your life.

Necrotic Venom.description: Corrosive venom that devours and restores.

Rat-a-tat Cannons.description: Scrap-mounted cannons rattle off a burst of pellets.

Servo Tail Lash.description: A hydraulic tail whips out from the mech's frame.

Toxic Cheese Fumes.description: The mech vents eye-watering fumes of improperly aged cheese.

Cheese Fondue.description: Molten cheese splashes over you while the rat snacks to patch its mech.

Overclock.description: The mech redlines its engines. The rat cackles.

Dev Smite.description: Super op dev move to insta kill enemies.
